review.context: Final paired battle conversations cover Asuka recovering her old enthusiasm, Teitania accepting silent feelings, and Suzune teasing the protagonist about Setsuko and the beauty contest.
decisions: Mari and C.C. use a talon/chili pun, adapted as hidden talons and making it hot literally.
The protagonist first admires Setsuko piloting; Suzune deliberately takes it romantically.
Darry is asked to cover Klan, while Suzune is asked to navigate.
